name: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd.
summary: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of various assets, such as industrial parks and innovation centers in China. The company offers investment promotion and operation services; and professional services, such as park planning consultation, building development, industrial investment and park operation, industrial services, industrial investment, and asset management, as well as industrial leasing and industrial new town services. The company was formerly known as China Fortune Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. in December 2007.
